claim: MTDSim's network is a three-layer hierarchical attack representation model (HARM) as defined by Hong and Kim (2012).
quote: we propose two-layer Hierarchical Attack Representation Model (HARMs). The upper layer (or level) captures the network inf ormation (e.g., reachability), and the lower layer captures the vulnerability information of hosts in the network in the HARMs.

fix_text: 'a three-layer hierarchical attack representation model (HARM) [hongkim2012harm]' -> 'a hierarchical attack representation model (HARM) [hongkim2012harm], extended from two layers to three'
